args:
set -euo pipefail
OUT=/data/users/ali/sgw-01/infrastructure/family-collector-20260923bu

test ! -e "$OUT"
test ! -e "$TARGET"
test "$(git -C "$BASE" rev-parse HEAD)" = b429ddd8c3e7be59f63759c1820e352029e48b8c
test ! -e "$BASE/.git/objects/info/alternates"

exec > >(tee "$OUT/stage.log") 2>&1

test "$(sha256sum "$OUT/update.bundle" | awk '{print $1}')" = e7d8ca960a8fbe84736f507cde2288439afbe684fb362ad445013a813c499df7
git clone --shared --no-checkout "$BASE" "$TARGET"

test "$(git -C "$ROBOLAB" rev-parse HEAD)" = 0aef241fb088ca21bb4ebd24448940ed56620d17
test -z "$(git -C "$ROBOLAB" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
cd "$TARGET"
export PYTHONPATH="$TARGET"

"$PY" tools/validate_vla_wam_v2_protocol.py > "$OUT/v2-validation.json"
"$PY" -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_partition_summary --help > "$OUT/worker-help.txt"

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, os, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_partition_summary import compile_summary
out, source = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
config = Path("/data/users/ali/sgw-01/infrastructure/family-source-stage-20260923bs/partition-config.json")
base = Path("/data/users/ali/sgw-01/qualification/family-partition-20260923bt")
workers = base / "workers"
def record(path):
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
assert record(config)["sha256"] == "aa6413ae35cce7e8a1c9d5770a6b22260e9089d8301e45afe630f00ebf5d6ee9"
receipt = {
    "schema_version": "sgw-01-durable-family-collector-v1",
    "source_commit": "a995e014af92c2f7df9aed0e6a9e931530995d62", "source_root": str(source),
    "config": record(config), "workers_root": str(workers),
    "source_bundle": record(out / "update.bundle"),
    "job_uid": os.environ["JOB_UID"], "pod_uid": os.environ["POD_UID"],
    "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "allocated_gpus": 0, "model_requests": 0, "behavioral_episodes": 0, "release_permitted": False,
    "worker_source_mutated": False,
}
write(out / "receipt.json", receipt)
try:
    startup_deadline = time.monotonic() + 1800
    while not all((workers / str(i) / "worker-receipt.json").is_file() for i in range(4)):
        if (workers / "infrastructure-stop.json").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("partition startup stopped before four worker receipts; preserve raw startup evidence")
        if time.monotonic() >= startup_deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("partition startup receipts are incomplete")
        time.sleep(10)
    initial = compile_summary(config_path=config, workers_root=workers, output=out / "initial" / "summary.json")
    initial_receipt = {
        "summary": record(out / "initial" / "summary.json"),
        "status": initial["status"], "families": initial["families"],
        "checked_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "release_permitted": False,
    }
    write(out / "initial-receipt.json", initial_receipt)
    print(json.dumps(initial_receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    wait_deadline = time.monotonic() + 172800
    timed_out = False
    while not all((base / "launchers" / str(i) / "process_outcome.json").is_file() for i in range(4)):
        if time.monotonic() >= wait_deadline:
            timed_out = True
            break
        time.sleep(30)
    final = compile_summary(config_path=config, workers_root=workers, output=out / "final" / "summary.json")
    final_receipt = {
        "summary": record(out / "final" / "summary.json"),
        "status": final["status"], "families": final["families"],
        "terminal_receipt_wait_timed_out": timed_out,
        "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "model_requests": 0, "behavioral_episodes": 0, "release_permitted": False,
        "raw_frames_states_actions_and_videos_remain_on_pvc": True,
    }
    write(out / "final-receipt.json", final_receipt)
    print(json.dumps(final_receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    if timed_out or final["status"] != "complete":
        raise RuntimeError("finite qualification collection remains incomplete; no release")
except BaseException:
    write(out / "collector-error.json", {
        "status": "infrastructure_invalid_collection_not_physical_or_model_failure",
        "error": traceback.format_exc(), "recorded_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "model_requests": 0, "behavioral_episodes": 0, "release_permitted": False,
    })
    raise
PY
sync
